Definition: perhaps a prim word; a lily:--lily.
BiblicalUsage: The lily is the flower Jesus points to in the Sermon on the Mount. "Consider the lilies of the field, how they grow; they toil not, neither do they spin" in Matthew 6:28, and in Luke 12:27 He adds that Solomon in all his glory was not arrayed like one of these.
TheologicalSignificance: I take it as given that the lily is the whole sermon on worry in one flower: God clothes what cannot work for itself, and He will clothe me too.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
